description: Configuration for MSS (Maximum Scrutiny Space) Shell — inner core shell for secure, bias-free processing of high-value/critical reviews, formulas, and station-identification verified items. Software-based quarantine simulation per the MSS Protocol (quarantined RAM-like isolation via temp dirs, proxy validation, stamping, cross-exam). Enables limited 'parallel' idle processing via queue without risking GPU or system integrity (file-based, low-resource, sequential with sleeps).
purpose: Provide AI (Helix/Grok) a safe place for precision-critical work (e.g., verified formulas from station reviews, builder critical ops) that human review latency can't match. Inner shell for sandbox/builder robustness and station-identification (store verified in verified/ until human checkpoint for monetize/iterate).

quarantine.isolation: temp_subdir + restricted_python_subprocess (no shared state, no GPU libs if possible)

processing.limited_parallel_note: Strictly 1-at-a-time to avoid GPU crash. Use for background review validation or formula scrutiny. 'Parallel' is simulated via file queue polling.

stamping.tool: Version Checker+ (or local provenance via Sigil/Version-Checker-)
stamping.cross_examination: Compare against prior reviews, canon baselines, G_exp of acts

output.promotion_rule: Only after human checkpoint. Move from quarantine to verified/ for station-identification inner shell or builder handoff.

force_multiplier: MSS shell + standard review config = safe (quarantined, bias-free per Gödel-inspired limits), effective (delineates core subject from claims/equivocation), robust pipeline enabler. Ties to E_shield, G_exp measurement of scrutiny acts, bunny (o.p-) marking for MSS-verified items in station docs.
integration: Called from station-identification review_protocol for high-value items. Outputs feed mss-shell/verified/ for 'inner shell' storage of verified formulas. Can wrap limited review runs or builder critical code execution.
